defmodule Fixtures.ControlFlow do
  def run(items, input, replacement) do
    {left, right} = pair()
    left.()
    right.()

    callback = fn -> helper() end
    callback.()
    callback = replacement
    callback.()

    case input do
      {:ok, value} when is_valid(value) -> value.()
      _ -> fallback()
    end
    value.()

    with {:ok, first} <- fetch(),
         second = prepare(first),
         true <- accept(second) do
      first.()
      second.()
    else
      {:error, reason} -> reason.()
    end
    first.()
    second.()
    reason.()

    for item <- items,
        prepared = prepare(item),
        accept(prepared) do
      item.()
      prepared.()
    end
    item.()
    prepared.()

    receive do
      {:message, payload} -> payload.()
    after
      0 -> timeout()
    end
    payload.()

    reference = &helper/1
    reference
  end

  def helper(value), do: value
end

  def run(
    entries: List[() => Unit],
    pairs: List[(() => Unit, () => Unit)],
    fallback: () => Unit,
  ): Unit =
    for
      entry <- entries
      prepared = prepare(entry)
      if accept(prepared)
    do
      entry()
      prepared()

    for (first, second) <- pairs do
      first()
      second()
    first()

      val (left, right) = pair(current)
      left()
      right()
    }
    current()

    lookup() match
      case Some(found) if validate(found) => found()
      case _ => fallback()

host = "127.0.0.1"
port = 8080

[server.tls]
certificate = "cert.pem"

"quoted key" = "value"
'literal key' = "literal"
site."google.com" = true

["service name"]
"display name" = "Search"

[["service name".instances]]
id = "primary"

include = "shared.toml"
extends = ["base.toml"]
command = "build()"

[imports]
source = "theme.css"

string = "hello"
multiline = """first
second"""
integer = 42
float = 3.14
boolean = false
date = 2026-07-15
time = 12:30:00
array = [1, 2, 3]
inline = { name = "Ada", active = true }

// @ts-nocheck -- CommonJS source-fact fixture under an ESM repository tsconfig.
module.exports = require("./replacement.cjs");

defaults: &defaults
  retries: 3
  timeout: 30

development:
  <<: *defaults
  endpoint: !env DEV_ENDPOINT

production:
  <<: *defaults
  endpoint: https://example.test

# File settings.
name: demo # trailing note

# Nested settings.
database:
  # Connection pool size.
  pool_size: 10

name: mimirs
enabled: true
server:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 8080
features:
  - chunking
  - analysis

%YAML 1.2
---
name: first
active: true
...
---
name: second
active: false

plain: hello
single: 'quoted'
double: "escaped\nvalue"
literal: |
  first line
  second line
folded: >-
  folded
  text
date: 2026-07-15
nullable: null

include: shared.yaml
extends:
  - base.yaml
imports:
  source: theme.css
command: build()

services:
  - name: api
    ports:
      - 8080
      - 8081
  - name: worker
    ports: [9000, 9001]
matrix:
  - [linux, x64]
  - [macos, arm64]
